hostile_fixture_summary.finding: Core single-predictor salience is present but the score formula/unit changed.
V547 exhaustive pair search finds A+B; current primary-conditioned secondary search never evaluates it.

V547 discovers the XOR pair but its shape classifier labels the question flat because the flat check precedes interaction-gain evaluation. Current V550 can miss the pair entirely because pair search is conditional on the single chosen primary.

Scalar salience/pair gain does not encode reversal direction. Current unary matrix preserves marginal conditionals but not the joint S×P response cells; secondary_gain likewise does not retain directional joint topology.
Minority information is split across current families; support behavior is family-specific.

Pair identity can be discovered historically but reversal semantics are not preserved by the V547 row; current secondary search is order-sensitive and its row also lacks the full joint response distribution.
Three-way interaction is invisible to both V547 pair search and current V550 greedy discovery. This is a shared limitation, not a V550-only loss.
Introducing survey weights reverses the selected primary predictor. Current V550's NMI and Cramer's V remain unweighted despite the weighted MI ranking.

Current V550 subtracts conditional entropy on the nonblank-X subset from baseline entropy on the full Y universe. Under predictor missingness the field named mutual_information is not generally MI and can be strongly positive under exact conditional independence.

metric_unit_check.finding: V547 raw MI uses sklearn natural-log units; current entropy-reduction/MI uses base-2 bits. Current normalized_mutual_information divides sklearn MI by base-2 entropy, so a perfect balanced binary association returns ln(2), not 1.
